sources.observedBehavior: Directory explains asynchronous delivery to an agent or an existing group the sender belongs to; outbound group publication is a side effect requiring user intent, not an automatic relay of private words.
A group target routes through postToGroup. This reconstructed version explicitly states group messages are text-only and does not deliver its image arguments to groups.
postToGroup rejects missing/non-group targets, non-members and pass text; records a public member message and schedules a bounded group turn on the agent lane.
Existing bounded round-robin/member routing, pass semantics and message limits; this orchestration was already adapted by CMB to durable group epochs.

grokReference.referenceBoundary: Behavior/protocol reference only for this new integration. The 0.18 reconstruction proves text publication to own groups, not generic binary group attachments or the current proprietary cloud backend. CMB reuses its own original-file storage/approval/file-card interfaces to support explicit originals.

reuse.behavior: Existing exact approval, run lease and atomic toolOnce/approvedToolOnce receipts.

Existing task-visible original selectors, immutable object aliases, per-type file limits and streaming integrity verification under sorted object locks; no extra whole-file copy or locks while waiting on human approval.
Previously adapted Grok group routing/pass and bounded round robin; existing durable queue, cycle and recovery machinery.
Existing message file cards and approval rendering, retaining original names, sizes, hashes and exact destination context.

implementation: Only list existing member groups; do not create guessed targets. Original public group assignment may be visible through verified parent lineage, but private transcript/history is not shared.
Freeze group identity/revision, named member identities/revisions, original route and latest cycle/cancellation status; recheck these with run ownership and selected file metadata at commit.

Commit exact public text, explicitly selected same-byte file aliases, provenance, tool receipt and any scheduler admission in one SQLite transaction. Lost acknowledgement replays the receipt without re-reading source bytes or waking again.

An active room continues without cancelling its original task. An idle public-origin cycle uses agent priority, never becomes human auto-review authority, and excludes the publisher from its initial recipients.

The active room turn may read explicitly published same-cycle originals even after its original trigger; unrelated/private/same-Bot artifacts, other branches and obsolete turns gain no broader access.
Late same-origin public continuation is verified through the publication source run parent chain. New human tasks, cancelled continuations and unrelated publications are not treated as the old task.

First public post counts toward both round and global message budgets. Its presence alone does not start another round when every recipient passes. Existing two-per-turn, ten-message and three-round limits remain bounded.

Room prompt contains this member's own same-cycle delivered peer receipt metadata (recipient, status, intent, original file names), not private bodies or returned content. This provides actual phase state; it is not proof that a real model will never duplicate work.
